name: lmgroktfy
description: Let me Grok that for you

scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:app
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run --cwd packages/web deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: bun run build:shared && cd apps/web && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging bunx astro build && bunx wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:prod: bun run build:shared && cd apps/web && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production bunx astro build && bunx wrangler deploy --env production
